### Community
- Create an account with your email: we send you a code to confirm it.
- Share a session with friends or everyone, from the Share button in Analyze.
- Add friends, give kudos and comment on their sessions; open any shared session in Analyze, with every graph.
- Leaderboards for every track, all time and this month, clockwise and anticlockwise (forward and reverse for stages).
- Link your TANKlemetry unit with the code from its box: your sessions get the verified badge.
- Forgot your password? Reset it with a code from your email.
### Timing
- The start/finish line is drawn on the map as a real line. Turn it and set its length by hand when the automatic one is off, and see each crossing counted as you adjust it.
